data.description: The Browns reverted Chatman (quadriceps) to IR on Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
The Browns placed Davis on injured reserve Tuesday due to a quadriceps injury.
The Browns placed Royer (personal) on the reserve/non-football illness list Sunday, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.
Ulofoshio (biceps) reverted to the Browns' IR on Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
The Browns placed Wright on injured reserve Sunday due to a ruptured Achilles, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Green (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the emergency third quarterback against the Panthers on Sunday, Kelsey Russo of the Browns' official site reports.
Sampson (knee) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.
Jenkins (back) was a limited participant in practice Thursday, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.
Campbell (ankle/hip/knee) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Kelsey Russo of the Browns' official site reports.
Delpit (shoulder) said he will play in Sunday's game against the Panthers, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.
The Steelers placed Kent (undisclosed) on the reserve/PUP list Monday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.
The Steelers placed Driscoll (undisclosed) on injured reserve Monday with a designation to return, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.
Porter (conditioning) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
The Steelers placed Dunker (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
Howard (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the Bengals on Sunday.
Fautanu (ankle) is officially listed as questionable for Sunday's game at New England, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
Pittman (foot) remains listed as questionable but is expected to play in Sunday's contest against the Bengals, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Warren (shoulder), who is listed as questionable for Week 3, is expected to play Sunday versus the Bengals, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Dean (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.
Heidenreich (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
Echols is being evaluated for a possible concussion and is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Bengals, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.
